title: A New Tablet Running Android 17 💻
body: Logic unveiled the Neo X1 Pro tablet: a 10.95-inch display with a 90Hz refresh rate, Android 17, an 8000 mAh battery, 8GB of memory with 128GB of storage expandable up to a terabyte, 4G connectivity, and two cameras of 13 and 8 megapixels.
Simply put: a mid-spec device aimed at education and everyday use, weighing 520 grams with light splash resistance.
No price or sale date has been announced yet.
Do you still use a tablet, or is your phone enough for you?
